summary: Iteration 9 focused verification of the 4 AI features with the live OpenAI-compatible key (https://www.chenzk.top/v1). Backend: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_ai_features.py — 5/5 passed (AI settings config, product-description, reports/ai-summary, product-image, parse-invoice graceful-failure check). Frontend (admin login taqim2609@gmail.com): Dashboard 'Laporan AI' generated a 1966-char structured Indonesian report in ~20s with 'Salin' button appearing; Products form AI description filled in ~5s with success toast 'Deskripsi AI dibuat'; AI image generated in ~35s and preview thumbnail rendered in the dialog; Inventory > Pembelian > Scan Faktur (AI) failed as expected (deepseek-v4-flash is text-only) but failed GRACEFULLY — error toast shown, dialog and page remained functional, no crash.

minor.issue: Returns 400 with the raw provider error string leaked to the client: "Gagal memanggil AI Vision: Error code: 400 - {'error': {'message': 'Failed to deserialize the JSON body ... unknown variant `image_url`, expected `text`'}}". Expected — vision feature is configured with the text-only model deepseek-v4-flash. Recommend (a) configuring a real vision model for features.vision and (b) sanitizing the message to a friendly Indonesian text (e.g. 'Model AI yang dipilih tidak mendukung pembacaan gambar. Ganti model Vision di Pengaturan AI.').

Returns the provider-hosted URL (https://mianyunai.com/generated-cy/...jpg) which is stored on the product. If the provider expires/rotates those URLs, product images will break permanently. Consider downloading and persisting as base64/local asset (the b64_json branch already exists but this provider returns url).

ui_bugs.issue: AI text is rendered as raw markdown (**bold**, ### headings, --- rules) inside a whitespace-pre-wrap div, so users see literal asterisks/hashes. Render markdown or ask the model for plain text.
The 'AI' button is absolutely positioned bottom-right inside the textarea and overlaps the generated description text (see screenshot), obscuring the last line.
Error toast displays the raw provider JSON/stack-like message to the end user (non-Indonesian, technical). Handled without crash, but message should be user friendly.

issues: Date picker uses the browser-native <input type=date> (08/21/2026 mm/dd/yyyy format) instead of a shadcn Calendar — inconsistent with the rest of the Indonesian UI and shows US date format.
Large amount of leftover TEST_* seed products from previous iterations (TEST_Mie_*, TEST_Rokok_*, TEST_PSTK_*, TEST_KAT2_* category) still in DB — should be cleaned before handover.

Sanitize AI error messages surfaced to the UI (parse-invoice) into friendly Indonesian text instead of raw provider JSON.
Render the AI summary markdown (or request plain text) so users don't see ** and ###.
Persist AI-generated images locally instead of storing the third-party provider URL.
Reposition the ai-desc-btn so it does not cover textarea text.
Clean up leftover TEST_* products/categories from the database.

rca_of_the_issue: parse-invoice 400 root cause: the provider rejects the OpenAI multimodal content array ('unknown variant image_url') because the configured model deepseek-v4-flash accepts text-only messages. Not a code bug — a model configuration limitation. Frontend handles it gracefully (toast, no crash).
